functions.name: cb_refresh_class
functions.doc:
Stores the registry's record. No record means the registry never classified the target: it is
 cached as `unknown`, which no sensible policy allows.

NEAR Account Identifier.

This is a unique, syntactically valid, human-readable account identifier on the NEAR network.

[See the crate-level docs for information about validation.](index.html#account-id-rules)

Also see [Error kind precedence](AccountId#error-kind-precedence).

## Examples

``` use near_account_id::AccountId;

let alice: AccountId = "alice.near".parse().unwrap();

assert!("ƒelicia.near".parse::<AccountId>().is_err()); // (ƒ is not f) ```

functions.name: cb_settle
functions.doc:
Settles a reservation. Success: what was used is spent and recorded as exposure. Failure: the
 reservation is released and nothing else changes (a failed call refunds the vault by protocol).
 For NEAR the whole amount is used when the call succeeded. For a token, `ft_transfer_call`
 returns the amount used; zero means the target took nothing.

functions.name: freeze_target
functions.doc:
Registry only (plan R16, KTD8). Marks a target frozen so the next spend to it is refused with
 `ARUNA_TARGET_FROZEN`. A target outside this vault's ceiling is ignored, not an error, because
 the registry pushes every freeze to every registered vault.

functions.doc:

 is the settlement's, from `cb_settle`.
 `token` is the token contract for `ft_swap` and must be omitted for `swap`.

functions.name: update_policy
functions.doc: Owner: any policy inside the ceiling. Operator: only one that permits nothing new.

functions.name: withdraw_to_owner
functions.doc:
Owner-only, available in every state, and pays only the registered owner (docs/CONTRACTS.md).
 `token` omitted means NEAR; a fungible token must be one the ceiling lists.

auto_disabled.description: Set when the vault paused the agent itself; only the owner can resume it.

last_loosened_at.description: Last block at which the policy was loosened; 0 if never. A claim on coverage bought before it is rejected (plan R10).

policy_version.description: Bumped on every policy change. Coverage records the version it was priced on (plan R10).

refusals.description: (block, weight) of agent-caused refusals inside the rolling window.

Budget.description: Per-agent daily accounting in one token. `reserved` is in flight: sent but not yet settled.

CachedClass.description: The vault's last recorded view of a target's class. Never a live read: no contract can read another account's state (docs/NEAR-FACTS.md §1).

classified_at_block.description: When the registry recorded it, shown to users.

fetched_at_block.description: When this vault fetched it; MAX_CLASS_AGE_BLOCKS applies to this.

Ceiling.description: The client's limits. Only the owner sets them; every agent policy must fit inside. A token not listed is a token this vault does not accept or spend: there is no conversion between tokens.

agent_allowance.description: Gas allowance given to each agent key, in yoctoNEAR. Must exceed one call's prepaid gas (docs/NEAR-FACTS.md §10, T6).

Reason.description: Canonical refusal reasons (docs/CONTRACTS.md). The SDK uses the same names without `ARUNA_`.

RiskClass.description: The four classes of docs/CLASSIFIER.md, ordered from least to most risky, so that `class <= policy.max_risk_class` is the policy check.

Simulation.description: What `simulate` returns. Not binding: state can change before a spend lands (docs/MCP.md).

class.description: The target's class as this vault last recorded it, if any.

verdict.description: "allow" or "block". There is no third verdict: no approval queues.

TokenCeiling.description: The owner's limits for one token. Amounts are in that token's smallest unit.

daily_total.description: Covers the sum of all agents' daily caps in this token, or an operator could reach any total by adding keys.

TokenId.description: The token an amount is denominated in (docs/plans/2026-11-10-2106-feat-coverage-loop-testnet-plan.md R1): NEAR itself, or a NEP-141 fungible token contract. Coverage, premiums, capital, payouts and exposure are always in one token; nothing converts between them.
